split_strategy: Manual. The hardest cases are the sibling-skill deferrals (N1 general AI-tool listing → find-ai-directories, N2 general SaaS launch → find-product-directories) and the 'find a directory vs find a server / hire a builder / DIY' confusions (N3 hiring a build firm, N4 recommend-a-server, N5 how-MCP-works). Those go in train. Validation tests generalization across remaining MCP-listing phrasings and out-of-scope shapes.
passing_rule: should_trigger=true → trigger_rate > 0.5 over 3 runs. should_trigger=false → trigger_rate ≤ 0.5.
